captures.description: PRESENC AI'S GEO ACADEMIC PAPERS, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29. Google first corrected the query to 'presence' and gave an unrelated Overview; the operator chose 'show results for presenc'. The Overview then: Presenc AI 'provides curated summaries and analyses' of GEO research; three of its pages (the 34-paper comprehensive summary, '10 Must-Read Studies', a case-studies benchmark); and the Princeton-led GEO paper as the field's foundation. Five cards, three Presenc's, with FancyAI and ResearchGate.
